title: How a Sink P-Trap Maintains a Water Seal
description: The P-trap is an essential safety fixture installed directly beneath sink drains to prevent hazardous sewer gas from entering buildings. Its signature curved dip retains a small volume of standing water after every use. This static water creates a continuous physical barrier between the building interior and the municipal sewer line. When fresh water flows down the drain, it pushes out old wastewater and replaces it, renewing the liquid seal. Proper alignment and correct dip depth are essential to prevent trap siphoning and maintain a safe barrier.

How a Sink P-Trap Maintains a Water Seal

The P-trap is an essential safety fixture installed directly beneath sink drains to prevent hazardous sewer gas from entering buildings. Its signature curved dip retains a small volume of standing water after every use. This static water creates a continuous physical barrier between the building interior and the municipal sewer line. When fresh water flows down the drain, it pushes out old wastewater and replaces it, renewing the liquid seal. Proper alignment and correct dip depth are essential to prevent trap siphoning and maintain a safe barrier.
